text:
Which statement about the extraction of aluminium by electrolysis is correct?
A
Aluminium is extracted from its ore, cryolite.
B
Aluminium is formed at the positive electrode.
C
Bauxite is used to lower the temperature of the extraction process.
D
Graphite is used for both the positive and negative electrodes.

options.label: A
options.text: Aluminium is extracted from its ore, cryolite.

options.label: B
options.text: Aluminium is formed at the positive electrode.

options.label: C
options.text: Bauxite is used to lower the temperature of the extraction process.

options.label: D
options.text: Graphite is used for both the positive and negative electrodes.
